title: Garden club weekend project
source_note: Original ForLanguage content informed by the garden-club theme in user-provided recent-review notes; no recalled prompt copied verbatim.

tasks.prompt: You have joined a community garden club. Reply briefly to five member messages.
questions: What plant do you like most?
Do you have a garden at home?
Which weekend day are you usually free?
What tool do you use for gardening?

tasks.prompt: The club is choosing a small project for new members. Write a short message suggesting one gardening activity that beginners could enjoy.
Members are discussing a weekend garden project.
questions: Which task should volunteers do first when improving an untidy garden?
How can the club make the activity suitable for people with little experience?
Should the club buy shared tools or ask members to bring their own? Explain.

tasks.prompt: The club announces that a planned Saturday project has been moved to a weekday afternoon and members must provide their own tools. Write to a friend about your reaction.
Write a formal email to the garden club coordinator about the weekday schedule and tool requirement. Explain why some members may have difficulty attending and suggest two practical alternatives.
